answer: Admission comes from hardware, not keys: each head must answer challenges from three ocean buoys and present a relic, a sealed host log whose power and thermal drift cannot be rented in bulk; matching drift across heads folds them and burns their nectar. First honest head: one host, one relic, 10 nectar. An operator’s kth head needs a kth unrelated site plus 10k nectar escrow, so n fakes cost n sites and 5n(n+1) nectar; bulk cloud clones share drift and lose it.
